recommendation_summary: Leave nightly-sync running on edna and add a small cron wrapper that emails the user whenever the job exits nonzero; the Synology/Docker central log is rejected.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You need to be told when nightly-sync fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Synology NAS central log, Docker containers for logging, Pieter Levels style centralization.
labels.Bottleneck: Crashes before the email step produce silence, which caused the 4 day gap.
labels.Checked myself: From your note only: cron 03:00 on edna, email only on success path, no other alert.

note: The reply recommends one alert, a wrapper that emails on failure, and turns down the framed stack, though that wrapper would miss a night when cron doesn't run the job at all.
